a.speaker: Tanager Fuel, Cornelius
a.text:
Saturday, October 2. You stop for gas with {teen.name} in the passenger seat. At pump four two men from out of town have a hose down the underground tank port and a row of red cans. The clerk is on the phone, hiding behind the counter.

One of them sees you see him. He lifts his shirt enough to show a pistol grip. "Keep driving."

options.text: "Police are four minutes out and the camera got your plates. Walk away now and it's just a bad day."
effects: You talked down the fuel thieves at Pump Four.

options.text: Drive away and call it in.
effects: You left Pump Four and called it in.

options.text: Strike first, before he can draw.

talked.speaker: Tanager Fuel
talked.text: A long second. Then the hose comes out of the port and they leave the cans. The clerk gives you a free fill-up and a look of something close to awe. {teen.name} doesn't say anything all the way home.

left.speaker: Tanager Fuel
left.text: You pull out slowly. In the mirror one of them raises a can at you like a toast. The police arrive in nineteen minutes. They're gone.
